newsitem.title: USA: Standard Commercial finalizes China deal.
newsitem.headline: Standard Commercial finalizes China deal.

text.p: Standard Commercial Corp said Thursday it finalized the agreement between its Trans-Continental Leaf Tobacco Corp unit and Guizhou Nanming Leaf Tobacco Co Ltd for a tobacco processing factory in China.
The project has received all necessary government approvals, and will be located in Guiyang, the capital of Guizhou Province in China.
Under the agreement, Trans-Continental will supply and oversee the installation of the processing machinery and quality control equipment for the Nanming factory.
Trans-Continental will be granted priority on all export processing and will receive payment for its services under a compensation trade agreement.
Nanming is a joint venture comprising several national, provincial and county government agencies.
The company said the Nanming factory will process tobacco for both export and domestic requirements. Construction is scheduled to be completed by October 1998 in time for next year's crop.
